title: Running Grid A* and Verifying That the Path Reaches the Goal
description: Call astar(grid, start, goal, eight=WORLD.eight_connected, heuristic="manhattan"), extract RES["path"], and print the node count and goal check.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Run `astar(grid, start, goal, eight=WORLD.eight_connected, heuristic="manhattan")` to store the search result dictionary in `RES` and extract the node sequence `path = RES["path"]`.
Print the number of nodes `len(path)` and verify `bool(path and path[-1]==goal)`.
Look at line 4 (`bool(path and path[-1]==goal)`). Checking `path` first guards against indexing an empty list when no path exists. `path[-1] == goal` checks that the last node in `path` is `goal`.

steps.question: If `path` contains 18 nodes from `start` (`path[0]`) to `goal` (`path[-1]`), what do lines 3 and 4 print?
steps.answer: Line 3 prints `Path length (number of nodes): 18` and line 4 prints `Reached goal: True`.

steps.description: After `astar` finishes, line 2 binds `path` to the 18-node list `RES["path"]`.
Line 4 confirms `path[-1] == goal` and prints `Reached goal: True`.
